metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: This beloved British sitcom features quirky, socially awkward characters and high-concept workplace comedy that matches the vibes of Silicon Valley and Peep Show.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: With its heartwarming character dynamics and positive outlook, this mockumentary is perfect for fans of Ted Lasso and Community.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced, comforting ensemble sitcom with a great heart, appealing directly to fans of Scrubs and New Girl.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: An incredibly sweet and hilarious animated family sitcom that offers excellent comfort viewing, perfect for fans of King of the Hill and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: The ultimate comfort and background show, this British comedy game show is laugh-out-loud funny and shares the chaotic, playful energy of Gogglebox.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: This riches-to-rags comedy features a highly eccentric family dynamic similar to Arrested Development, but with the heartwarming growth found in Ted Lasso.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A chaotic mockumentary about vampire roommates that captures the cynical absurdity of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia and the high-concept humor of Community.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: A legendary British teen comedy packed with awkward, cringe-inducing humor that perfectly aligns with Peep Show and PhoneShop.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: An incredibly witty, fast-paced adult animated series featuring a dysfunctional workplace dynamic, sharing cast members and sharp humor with Arrested Development.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A warm, queer, and lighthearted pirate adventure comedy that serves as the perfect bridge between Ted Lasso's sincerity and ONE PIECE's nautical fun.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: Created by the mastermind behind One-Punch Man, this anime delivers the same incredible blend of top-tier animation, thrilling action, and laugh-out-loud comedy.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: Set in 1990s Northern Ireland, this hilarious and heartwarming coming-of-age comedy matches the nostalgic family chaos of Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Co-created by the minds behind Ted Lasso and Scrubs, this warm, hilarious, and emotional comedy-drama is an instant comfort classic.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: A rapid-fire, joke-dense workplace sitcom that matches the witty, fast pacing and eccentric humor of Arrested Development and Community.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A wildly funny, chaotic buddy comedy set in NYC that matches the high-energy friendship dynamics of New Girl and the cynicism of Always Sunny.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult-classic workplace sitcom about struggling actors working for a catering company, ideal for fans of Silicon Valley's cynical, underdog humor.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: This chaotic, awkward British sitcom about an incompetent lettings agent features the same mockumentary feel and British cringe elements of PhoneShop.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A wonderfully charming, lighthearted comedy about a young couple who inherits a haunted country manor filled with friendly, eccentric historical ghosts.

metas.name: The Great British Baking Show
metas.description: The ultimate gentle, feel-good background TV show. It's incredibly warm, low-stakes, and highly comforting for quiet evenings.

metas.name: Gravity Falls
metas.description: A fantastic, mystery-filled animated adventure series that appeals to fans of Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency and Futurama's sci-fi charm.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Co-created by Rob McElhenney of Always Sunny, this workplace comedy set at a video game studio captures the tech-world satire of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Fresh Meat
metas.description: Created by the team behind Peep Show, this comedy-drama follows an eccentric group of university housemates, blending sharp wit with painful awkwardness.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, joke-heavy hang-out sitcom with a tight-knit friend group, perfect for fans who loved the vibe of New Girl.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A highly underrated corporate satire that feels like a cross between Silicon Valley and Arrested Development, featuring meta-humor and quirky characters.

metas.name: Harley Quinn
metas.description: A chaotic, hilarious, and action-packed adult animation that mirrors the fast-paced absurdity of Rick and Morty and the dark comedy of Always Sunny.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A critically-acclaimed, razor-sharp political satire featuring brilliant insult comedy and rapid-fire dialogue, ideal for fans of Arrested Development.

metas.name: Adventure Time
metas.description: A beautiful, imaginative animated series that transitions from lighthearted background fun to lore-heavy adventure, matching the tone of ONE PIECE.

metas.name: Trying
metas.description: An incredibly sweet, feel-good British comedy series that shares the same overwhelming warmth, optimism, and charm as Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Friday Night Dinner
metas.description: A highly eccentric British family sitcom built on repetitive gags, chaotic physical comedy, and quirky dynamics, great for Malcolm in the Middle fans.

metas.name: How To with John Wilson
metas.description: A unique, comforting, and deeply funny documentary-style show that serves as a quiet masterpiece of observation, matching the low-key charm of Gogglebox.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A loving sci-fi adventure comedy that channels the spirit of Star Trek with a humorous, lighthearted twist, appealing directly to fans of Futurama.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A heartwarming, easy-to-watch family sitcom centered around a Korean-Canadian convenience store, perfect for a relaxing background watch.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by Bill Lawrence (the mind behind Scrubs and Ted Lasso), this sitcom starts as a dating comedy but quickly evolves into a cozy, hilarious hang-out show.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern mockumentary classic about teachers in a Philadelphia public school, bringing the sweet, comfortable ensemble comedy of Parks and Rec.

metas.name: Workaholics
metas.description: A stoner-adjacent slacker sitcom about three roommates who work together, matching the chaotic buddy energy of PhoneShop and Always Sunny.

metas.name: Regular Show
metas.description: An absurdist animated sitcom about two slackers whose mundane tasks always spiral into cosmic, supernatural adventures, appealing to Futurama fans.

metas.name: This Country
metas.description: A brilliant mockumentary following two cousins in a mundane rural British town, carrying the same dry, brilliant character work found in Peep Show.

metas.name: Grand Designs
metas.description: A deeply satisfying and visually cozy British architectural docuseries that makes for excellent, comforting background viewing akin to MythBusters.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: An incredibly geeky, pop-culture-obsessed British comedy directed by Edgar Wright, serving as a spiritual precursor to Community.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A deadpan musical comedy about a New Zealand band trying to make it in New York, perfect for viewers looking for whimsical, easygoing laughs.
